facts.text: LakeShore336 is a minimal QCoDeS driver for the Lake Shore Model 336 temperature controller
The class reads inputs A-D, gets and sets loops 1-4, gets and sets heater ranges on outputs 1-2, configures OUTMODE and RAMP, and offers manual heater output MOUT
The class does not send *RST on init, to preserve sensor curves and setup; it sends only *CLS
The constructor passes name and address to VisaInstrument and writes *CLS
The valid sensor channels are A, B, C and D
Heater ranges off, low, medium and high map to codes 0, 1, 2 and 3, and max is an alias for high
Output modes off, closed loop, zone, open loop, monitor and warmup map to codes 0 to 5
The control input code maps none to 0 and A to D to 1 to 4
get_temperature sends KRDG? <channel> and returns a float in Kelvin
get_sensor_units sends SRDG? <channel> and returns the raw float sensor reading
get_setpoint and set_setpoint use SETP? and SETP with the loop index, in the preferred units of the control input, which the docstrings call usually Kelvin
get_ramp and set_ramp use RAMP? and RAMP with the rate and state
get_heater_range and set_heater_range use RANGE? and RANGE with the output index and range code; set_heater_range accepts the text names off, low, medium and high
set_manual_output sends MOUT <output>,<percent> and documents 0 to 100 percent of full scale
get_output_mode parses OUTMODE? into mode code and text, input code and text, and a power-up flag
set_output_mode sends OUTMODE <output>,<mode>,<input>,<powerup> and documents the accepted mode and input names
main.py configures output 1 in closed loop with sensor A, heater range high, and a 1 K/min ramp disabled
The README lists the Keithley 2634B source-measure unit and the LakeShore 336 temperature controller as the supported instruments

operator_required.name: setpoint
operator_required.reason: no text of the clone states the accepted setpoint range of the Lake Shore 336; the range depends on the installed sensor, heater and cryostat, so the site states it

operator_required.name: ramp_rate
operator_required.reason: the clone only says 'typically 0.1-100 K/min' in a comment and points to a manual that is not in the clone (instruments/lakeshore_336.py:243); the site states the allowed ramp rate of its installation

safe_state.description: heater outputs 1 and 2 commanded off: the e-stop sends RANGE n,0 and OUTMODE n,0,0,0 without a readback, and the safe-state action sends the same and fails unless RANGE? and OUTMODE? read off for both outputs; stored setpoints and ramps stay, nothing is cooled and no previous configuration is restored, so the sample can keep changing temperature; the class addresses heater outputs 1 and 2 only
